identity.summary: A focused introduction to data science built from Microsoft's open 'Data Science for Beginners' curriculum: what data science is, its ethical obligations, the kinds of data practitioners work with, and how to produce an honest visualization of quantitative data.

brief.audience: Students and professionals new to data science, with only basic computer literacy assumed
brief.intended_learning_outcome: Explain what data science is, recognize its ethical obligations and the main kinds of data, and produce a simple honest visualization of quantitative data

sources.title: Data Science for Beginners - Lesson 1: Defining Data Science

access.basis: Public MIT-licensed Microsoft curriculum on GitHub

sources.activity_purpose: Frame the field: understand what data science is, what data scientists do, and how it relates to statistics and AI.
sources.activity_instructions: Read the lesson and watch its intro video, then write a one-sentence definition of data science in your own words and list two tasks a data scientist performs.

sources.title: Data Science for Beginners - Lesson 2: Data Science Ethics

access.basis: Public MIT-licensed Microsoft curriculum on GitHub

sources.activity_purpose: Understand the ethical obligations that apply before any analysis: privacy, consent, bias, and accountability.
sources.activity_instructions: Read the lesson, then note three data-ethics principles and one example of how each could be violated in a real project.

sources.title: Data Science for Beginners - Lesson 3: Defining Data

access.basis: Public MIT-licensed Microsoft curriculum on GitHub

sources.activity_purpose: Learn the vocabulary of data: structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data and where each comes from.
sources.activity_instructions: Read the lesson, then classify three datasets you have seen (for example a spreadsheet, a set of emails, a folder of photos) by structure and source.

sources.title: Data Science for Beginners - Lesson 9: Visualizing Quantities

access.basis: Public MIT-licensed Microsoft curriculum on GitHub

sources.activity_purpose: Apply the ideas: choose an appropriate chart for a quantity and understand what makes a visualization honest.
sources.activity_instructions: Work through the lesson, then sketch or describe one chart for a small dataset and note one choice you made to avoid misleading the reader.
